'''K'lar''' was the title held by the patriarch of each individual tribe of [[Kriek]]. [[Kavakoderakanbnuarria]] was the k'lar of the [[Kherkhaman]] tribe during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Scout">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>
